_contract.nodes: every node ref resolves against buildColliders().nodes — the 15 frozen R24 keys (core/level/colliders.js)
_contract.weapons: every weapon ref resolves against WEAPONS in core/weapons/weapon_data.js (R4 ids: warden/vesper/corvus/pike)
_contract.gate: A1's makeMission()/selftest contract gate throws on ANY dangling spawn/wave/objective/archetype/node/weapon/scenario ref (the Colosseum empty-bout lesson)
_contract.triggers: trigger vocabulary: {kind:'missionStart'} | {kind:'beat',beat} | {kind:'reach',node|area,radius?} (area=[[minX,minZ],[maxX,maxZ]]) | {kind:'contact',beat} (first shot by anyone OR first bot confirm while that beat is active) | {kind:'waveAlive',wave,lte} (wave fully spawned AND alive<=lte) | {kind:'objective',id} (fires when that objective completes) | {kind:'anyOf',of:[...]}
_contract.beatOrdering: beats advance strictly in order; only the NEXT beat's trigger is armed (entering a later beat's area early does nothing). Known edge: a rusher entering the arcade during beat 3 can have 9 bots alive briefly (5 plaza + 4 arcade) — above LD's 8 content guidance, inside the 12 engine budget (R23); A1's spawner may queue above 12, never above.

fiction.premise: A storm blackout has cut the ward's grid. Vektor Ancile, a delisted PMC turned arms broker, is moving CINDERLOCK — a stolen missile-guidance module — through Meridian Ward to a freighter that sails at dawn. Infiltrate from the freight canal, seize the case at the handoff point, and hold Customs Gate 9 until extraction.
fiction._ip: all names invented for this project (level_design §1/§7 — no real brands, cities, units, or CoD references)

scenarios._comment: R10 canonical battery ids. Poses live HERE (A2); per-scenario capture seeds/params also live in _harness/shots.js (A11) and setScenario(id, seedObj) consumes both (R21). Camera pos/lookAt are authoritative for aim; scenarios.js derives player yaw/pitch from them. All captures: 1920x1080, DPR 1.5, post chain on, after prewarm.

S1.poseSource: market_neon_rain (LD §8 S3, hero) — player slid 2.5 m SW off LD's camera point, which sits inside pl_car_6's collider (first-person pose needs a valid capsule)
S1._w3: iter03 composition pass (W3): lookAt rotated 5 deg E onto the neon wall (iter02 spent the left 40% of the frame on unlit plaza) and a CQB contact added at 16 m — iter02 had its nearest bot at 24 m reading as a smudge, so the firefight had no legible subject. Depth now: weapon (0.5 m) / 16 m contact / 24-40 m contacts / neon wall 42 m / roofline.
S1.mustShow: full pre-blackout neon wall (all 5 signs), hero puddle planar reflections bottom-third, a LEGIBLE lead contact at ~16 m plus >=2 further bots in the kiosk field, player Warden muzzle flash light live, catenary lamps overhead, rain against neon

S2.vt: ADS on an AI at range
S2.poseSource: boulevard_long_rain re-posed (R10; F4 iter01 amendment: slid 5 m E along the barricade line — the LD point put L_BLVD_1's pole ~4 deg off the sight axis, a pole dead-center of the scope picture at 16 m)
S2._w3: iter03 scenario-truth pass (W3): the iter02 target was the platform marksman at 82 m standing in NO practical — 40 px tall and unlit, so the frame did not read as 'ADS on an AI'. Player moved into the boulevard centre lane at Z+18 and the marksman re-posed into the L_BLVD_3 sodium pool (36,7,-28) at 44 m — top-lit, ~75 px tall, unmistakably a man. A second contact at 22 m off the roadway edge fires, so a tracer and a flash sit in the mid depth. Sight axis stays dead down the clear centre lane: no pole, no wire, no car in the sight picture.
S2.mustShow: Corvus sight picture centred on a top-lit contact at ~44 m in the L_BLVD_3 pool, a second contact firing at ~22 m frame-right, sodium pools receding into fog, tram wires converging overhead

S3.vt: establishing wide of the compound, mid-firefight
S3.poseSource: dock_infil_skyline (LD §8 S1) — RE-AIMED and re-cast, W3 iter03
S3._w3: iter03 scenario-truth pass (W3). iter02's lookAt (-18,6,90) aimed 40 m PAST the far bank of the canal at Z+90, i.e. off the map into open water: the capture was a rain vista with no compound, no subject, no foreground and no combat. Two faults fixed at once. (a) TRUTH: the pose is now a firefight — the player is un-lowered with a 4-round fireBurst (guaranteed muzzle flash + leased light, gated by shots.js `until`), and three quay bots are pinned firing, so tracers are in flight from both directions. (b) COMPOSITION: camera slid W to (-44,49) and swung ~78 deg onto the quay run east, which puts L_QUAY (-30,6.5,47) 1 deg off the sight axis at 16 deg elevation (upper third, the light source doing work), the compound rooflines and the plaza glow along the right of frame, the canal and city-glow band on the left, and the quay edge/railing as the foreground anchor. Depth layers: weapon 0.5 m / lead contact 21 m / second contact 36 m / roofline 60 m+ / skyline ring.
S3.mustShow: a READABLE firefight: >=2 bots engaged at 20-40 m, player muzzle flash lighting the quay and the rain, tracers in flight, the player weapon in frame; L_QUAY's sodium pool + god-ray cone upper-left of centre; compound rooflines and the canal/city-glow band carrying the establishing read; no hard skybox seam (v2.2 amendment retained: the L_QUAY clause is now SATISFIED by this re-aim, not dropped)

S4.vt: close-up ground/wall material in practical light
S4.poseSource: Pale Lantern Arcade ground floor, lightwell drip pool (F4 iter01 amendment, orchestrator-directed: S4 moves INSIDE the arcade interior — the alley pose stood 3.5 m behind L_ALLEY_A's own pole staring through its god-ray cone card, so the frame read as an orange-fogged courtyard, never a material close-up; the interior L_ARCADE_SKY practical delivers the same VT intent with the drip pool as the mirror)
S4._w3: iter03 pass (W3): the arcade-interior pose captured a featureless blue haze ellipse — the L_ARCADE_SKY god-ray cone card sat BETWEEN camera and floor at 4.5 m, so the frame was cone alpha, not material, and nothing in it survived scrutiny. S4 moves to the plaza's east neon wall: a low (0.95 m) crop of wet cobble under the neon_wall_pools with the sign colours streaked along the wet stone toward the lens, plus the wall base and its grime line for the dielectric/roughness split. The arcade shaft is NOT lost — S7 is that frame, and it keeps the interior/rain-occlusion proof.
S4.mustShow: close crop of WET COBBLE from ~2 m to ~6 m under the neon wall: elongated magenta/cyan/amber practical reflections running toward the lens (the contracted rain payoff), roughness variance between stone crowns and joint water, wall base with its grime/tide line, NO uniform-roughness plastic read

S5.poseSource: tram-platform deck looking S over the boulevard (R10)
S5._w3: iter03 composition pass (W3): iter02 pitched only 2 deg above level at fov 50, so the boulevard buildings ate the horizon and the sky was a featureless strip — the ONE thing the frame exists to show. Pitch raised to ~7 deg and fov opened to 62: sky now owns the top two thirds with the horizon event and city-glow band on the skyline, the 78 m lane and its sodium pools recede along the bottom third, and the platform canopy edge anchors the foreground.
S5._pose_fix_iter05: x 38 -> 37.76, z -48 -> -48.07. The authored stand sat inside collider 'pf_nest_front' and setScenario rescued it 0.25 m every take ('SPAWN INSIDE GEOMETRY ... FIX THE POSE in content.json'). These are the rescued coordinates. S5 renders through the authored camera override, so the frame is unchanged.
S5.mustShow: sky owning the upper two thirds: storm ramp + >=2 parallax cloud layers + sodium-pollution horizon band, harbor/crane silhouettes on the skyline over the canal, boulevard sodium pools receding along the bottom third

S6.poseSource: ESC overlay over a live plaza frame (R10)
S6._w3: iter03 (W3): camera kept in lockstep with S1's re-aimed hero framing so the pause overlay is graded over the same plaza composition. NOTE (cross-file, reported by W3): the HUD and the ESC overlay are DOM (core/hud/*.js), and __test.capture() reads the WebGL drawing buffer with gl.readPixels — DOM chrome is physically absent from every battery PNG. iter02's S6 was NOT a pause-overlay failure: isPaused() was true and the overlay was up on screen. The capture path is what cannot see it.
S6.mustShow: pause overlay legible over the blurred live plaza frame; HUD state intact beneath

S7.vt: supplementary — interior god-ray shaft, rain-occlusion proof
S7._w3: iter03 composition pass (W3): iter02's lookAt put frame CENTRE at pitch -21.5 deg, so the shaft head (+12 deg) was pushed against the top edge and ~70% of the frame was unlit black floor. lookAt y raised 0.5 -> 3.95 (centre pitch ~-6 deg): the shaft now spans roughly -18 to +18 deg — head, column and floor pool all inside the frame. A CQB contact stands at the pool's rim so the shaft has a rim-lit SUBJECT and a human scale reference instead of an empty cone.
S7.mustShow: the WHOLE L_ARCADE_SKY shaft in frame — head, column, and the wet lightwell floor pool — with a rim-lit contact standing at the pool edge for scale, drip column sparkling in the beam, ZERO rain streaks indoors, CINDERLOCK table edge-lit frame left

S8.poseSource: gate9_floodlight_stand (LD §8 S6; F4 iter01 amendment: camera pulled back to the gate line + fov 55->68 — from LD's (0,-52) the flood poles sat 70-83 deg off-axis, geometrically outside any playable fov, same class of unsatisfiable clause as the v2.2 L_QUAY drop; bots slid W into the L_FLOOD_W beam path so the silhouettes actually stand in light)
S8._w3: iter03 composition pass (W3). Measured from the iter02 pose: BOTH flood poles sat at 51 deg off-axis, against a 50.2 deg horizontal half-fov — i.e. exactly on the frame edges — so one beam clipped in at the right margin and the left 55% of the capture was an unlit black wall. The 'both beams entering from the frame edges' clause is geometrically self-defeating: any framing wide enough to hold both poles centres on the dead ground between them. Amended to a HERO-BEAM framing (same class of amendment as the v2.2 L_QUAY drop): camera swung ~44 deg E onto L_FLOOD_E (18,9,-44), which now sits 8 deg off-axis at 20 deg elevation, and the wave-3 cast re-posed INTO that beam's cone (its axis runs from the head down to ground at x=18, z=-24.7) so the silhouettes are genuinely backlit at three depths — 25 m, 28 m, 35 m. The black wall is out of frame.
S8.mustShow: the L_FLOOD_E god-ray beam full of rain as the frame's subject (upper right of centre, source visible), wave-3 bots INCLUDING the juggernaut heavy backlit inside that beam at three depths, jersey field foreground, no dead unlit quarter of frame

S9.vt: supplementary — soldier close-up ~2 m, running clip, never bind pose
S9.poseSource: R10 supplementary (F4 iter01 amendment: camera anchored relToBot 0 — the pinned running bot covers ~2.5 m during the settle ticks, so an absolute camera loses the 2 m framing; pos/lookAt are now OFFSETS from the bot's post-settle position)
S9.mustShow: Meshy soldier at ~2 m mid-RUN clip (never bind pose), wet-shoulder spec, tint variant readable (v2.2 amendment: 'Vektor patch' removed — body texture carries no faction patch and adding one needs texture regen, per A8; tint + silhouette carry faction identity in v1)

C1.vt: 6 s capture: sprint -> stop -> fire burst -> reload
C1._w3: iter03 pass (W3): iter02's run started at (-10,36) on yaw 0 and stopped short of the plaza, so the reload-mid frame was unlit ground with nothing in it and no target for the burst. Start slid W and the heading canted NE so the 3 s tac-sprint lands the stop-and-fire inside the plaza facing the neon wall; two contacts pinned firing at 19 m and 16 m give the burst a subject and put a second muzzle flash in the reload frame. god:true so wave fire cannot end the take mid-script.
C1._pose_fix_iter05: x -14 -> -13.5. The authored start sat exactly ON the east face of collider bld_s1 (bbox [-41,0,18]..[-14,9,42]), i.e. INSIDE it once the capsule radius is applied, so setScenario's unstickPlayer() rescued every take with 'SPAWN INSIDE GEOMETRY ... FIX THE POSE in content.json' and the capture depended on that rescue. -13.5 is the position the rescue itself resolved to and the position iter05's 18.55 m sprint was actually run from, so the framing is unchanged; only the dependency on the rescue is gone.
